Purpose: Authoritative regression contract for processes AV Workstation Toolkit directly launches. This file documents boundaries and does not grant execution authority.

Launches.Boundary: The launcher constructs this fixed argument vector. Unsupported launcher arguments are rejected.
Only a direct request JSON child of AV Workstation Toolkit logs\requests is accepted; the worker revalidates exact package IDs and policy.

Launches.Initiator: Shipping PowerShell runtime or non-shipping compiled read-only inventory provider
Launches.Boundary: The executable must be the registered Microsoft Desktop App Installer winget.exe beneath protected Program Files\WindowsApps with a valid Microsoft Authenticode signature. The compiled Phase 3 provider exposes only fixed version, export, and update-list argument vectors; shipping change actions remain one exact allowlisted package ID.
The constant bridge argument is the only process argument. Strict bounded JSON travels over redirected standard input; credentials never enter arguments or environment variables.
Used only for explicit Open logs and Show verified file actions. AV Workstation Toolkit does not execute the selected installer.
Used only for explicit operator requests to open catalogued official product or download pages.
Optional read-only snapshot collection only; not part of normal desktop startup.
